title: Chess Records That Sound Fake
post: Chess records that sound fake: a 269-move game that lasted over 20 hours and ended in a draw, Magnus going 125 games without a loss, Fischer's 20 wins in a row, 64 hours nonstop in Times Square and 48 blindfold games on an exercise bike. #chess #chesstok #worldrecord #magnuscarlsen #bobbyfischer

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: One chess game lasted over 20 hours.
phrases.say: [excited] One chess game lasted over twenty hours.

phrases.text: Belgrade, 1989. Two players made 269 moves. And it ended in a draw.
phrases.say: Belgrade, nineteen eighty-nine. Two players made two hundred sixty-nine moves. And it ended... [sighs] in a draw.

phrases.text: Number four. Magnus Carlsen didn't lose a classical game for over two years. 125 games in a row.
phrases.say: Number four. Magnus Carlsen didn't lose a classical game for over two years. A hundred and twenty-five games in a row.

phrases.text: Number three. Bobby Fischer won 20 games in a row on his way to the world title.
phrases.say: Number three. Bobby Fischer won twenty games in a row on his way to the world title.

phrases.text: Two of his matches ended six to zero.
phrases.say: [impressed] Two of his matches ended... six to zero.

phrases.text: Number two. Two players in Times Square played for 64 hours straight. 473 games.
phrases.say: Number two. Two players in Times Square played for sixty-four hours straight. Four hundred seventy-three games.

phrases.text: Number one. Timur Gareyev played 48 games at the same time. Blindfolded. While riding an exercise bike.
phrases.say: [impressed] Number one. Timur Gareyev played forty-eight games at the same time... blindfolded... while riding an exercise bike.

phrases.text: Which one sounds the most fake? Follow for more.
phrases.say: [playful] Which one sounds the most fake? Follow for more.
